nodes.label: MSTFormer (Multi-Stream Transformer) — architectural concept
nodes.rationale: core thesis contribution: fuses pose sequences, court geometry, and multi-stream visual crops through a single Transformer with a dual-head output, instead of treating action recognition as single-frame classification or using only one modality.

nodes.label: Three-Stage CV Pipeline (Court Detection → Pose Tracking → Action Recognition)
nodes.rationale: each stage is independently swappable, letting court/pose/action components be developed and evaluated separately before being chained into the full pipeline.

nodes.label: Dual-Head Output (5-class action classification + binary keyframe detection)
nodes.rationale: joint training of action classification and keyframe detection lets the model learn temporally precise stroke boundaries alongside coarse action labels rather than treating them as unrelated tasks.
